title: Why can’t family support facilitate the sustainable development of students’ home-based online learning: a mixed-methods study from western China households
core_idea: Investigate why family support is not enabling sustainable home-based online learning for students in western China by examining parental dilemmas, capacities, and the broader impact of large-scale online teaching, using a mixed-methods design to explore potential paths for improvement.
tldr: A mixed-methods study that explores the barriers and dilemmas of parental support for sustainable student home-based online learning in western China, aiming to inform family, school, and policy approaches without presenting specific results.
